description: Frozen optimiser settings for all IrO2(110) H adsorption runs. All 2H pair optimisations and all restarts use this file. triage_runs.py hashes this file into every metadata record.

constraint.rule: freeze all atoms with z below z_freeze_A

notes: xtb_version is a required pin: fill it in from 'xtb --version' before launching the pair batch. The triage script warns while it is unset.
